normal.text: Portal, running right on my phone, a Snapdragon Gen 2. I'm not used to screen controls, and I'll for sure be plugging in a BT controller but this is nuts! Performance around 30-40fps 🫪 #steam #arm64 #snapdragon #valve

normal.name: Lambda Moses
normal.text: August 29: my legs were sore, good time for the magical healing power of Amtrak dining car food. I took the Southwest Chief from LA to Chicago. I'll post more photos later. Here the train passed by what's left of a historic roundhouse where Santa Fe 3751 lives. There's a documentary about how she was restored after rusting away for decades. I nicknamed her Magnolia the Magnificent, and the Siemens Charger is nicknamed Sophie. #losangeles #trains #railfan #steam #darktable #amtrak
